caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden side table with a reddish-brown hue, rendered against a plain, beige background. The table has a rectangular top with slightly rounded and beveled edges. Below the tabletop is a single central drawer, visible on the front, featuring a small keyhole and a metal pull ring. The table is supported by four turned, rounded legs, two on each side, which connect both to the tabletop and a circular lower shelf. This lower shelf serves as a brace and is situated close to the bottom of the structure. Three cabriole legs extend outward from the circular lower shelf, giving the table stability and an ornate appearance. The wood grain and shading are detailed, emphasizing the dimensionality and texture of the table's surfaces. There are no other objects or decorations in the image.
title: Bedside Table
